tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version numbering scheme

No decision on the version numbering scheme is currently recorded for this project. Until one is recorded, this document does not state a scheme, and none should be assumed.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/version-scheme.md`. It says that no decision on the version numbering scheme is currently recorded, and it doesn't name a scheme.

I wrote it that way because Muninn's list of recorded decisions has no version-scheme entry, and `muninn why` reported the records as insufficient. The only related material is two chat excerpts, which are unverified. One favours CalVer and a later one favours SemVer, but neither was recorded as a decision. I left both out of the file.

To record a scheme, state it as an explicit decision and I'll update the file.
